Indeed, many people encounter references to Ratatoskr numerous times during the course of a day without ever knowing that each time a curse is uttered or a story about the defeat of a much larger foe is told, Ratatoskr hears it wherever he might be, and he smiles.

The public face of the Nut Bringer is a human-sized ratatosk with tiny silver tusks and a golden horn protruding from his forehead. When he appears to his faithful, Ratatosk speaks telepathically in a whispering voice, brimming with suppressed laughter.

entries.name: Worshipers
entries: Ratatoskr is primarily worshiped by his namesake ratatosk, and his faith in the Northlands is centered in Hrafnheim. Among other communities, the Acorn Thief is venerated by messengers and tricksters of all stripes, as well as those who undertake insurmountable-seeming tasks, or who must travel to different planes of existence from the Mortal Realm. Such wayfarers often make offerings of cracked hazelnuts to the Nut Bringer for luck on their journeys. The followers of the Squirrel God view secrets as a challenge to uncover and share. In a plane-spanning multiverse of the powerful and frightening, he is an irrepressible source of joy and humor.

The Lord of Secrets teaches his followers to gather choice rumors and whispers as they would the finest acorns, to share their collected tidbits freely, to guide the lost and the wandering, and to always respect mighty Yggdrasil.

entries.name: Symbols And Books
entries: Ratatoskr's symbol is a golden acorn.

Though it is widely thought that the Chitterer has no holy books or tomes of faith, this is untrue. The tenets of Ratatoskr's faith, titled the Bok of Vel, or the Book of Wiles, are written on ancient, preserved leaves that originally fell from Yggdrasil, bound together with a twig broken from one of its branches. The only known copy of the Bok is in Runaskr. On its leaves are detailed the many meetings of the Tree Runner and the Lord of Eagles in Yggdrasil's canopy, as well as the numerous tricks he has played on Nidhogg, the First Dragon, whose lair lies beneath the tree's roots.

entries.name: Shrines and Priests
entries: The only formal temple to Ratatoskr in the Northlands is located in Runaskr, but shrines to the Nut Bringer can be found on many of Yggdrasil's branches, as well as at the foot of many of the other World Trees scattered throughout the planes. His shrines are piled with acorns and nuts left as offerings in exchange for speedy and safe travel.
The Squirrel God's priesthood includes ratatosk, ravenfolk, as well as a smattering of werekin.

deity.name: Bragi
deity.title: The Golden-Tongued Skald
entries: Bragi is the robust god of music, poetry and storytellers. It is said that doves are the ears of Bragi, and he gifts one of his wife's apples of immortality to bards who tell such rousing tales of the Aesir that even doves flock to hear them.

deity.name: Chernobog
deity.title: Architect of Disaster
entries: The amorphous horror Chernobog is the embodiment of all mortal fears. He is an ever-hungering devourer of souls who can be recognized by his coal-like eyes, regardless of the form he takes. When Chernobog walks the earth, he is accompanied by howling winds and the unquiet dead.

deity.name: Eir
deity.title: Goddess of Healing
entries: Eir was once a Valkyrie, but where her sisters picked through the slain, she chose who would live and recover their health. In return for her dedication, Wotan raised her to become a goddess of healing and medicine.

deity.name: Fenris
deity.title: Father of Wolves
altNames: Devourer of the Sun and Moon
entries: One of Loki's children and the brother of Jormungandr and Hel, the monstrous wolf Fenris was bound by the Aesir and anchored to his prison by the primeval earth elemental called Thviti. As punishment for biting off Tyr's hand while attempting to break free of its fetters, the gods imprisoned the wolf in supernatural sleep within a hidden cavern. Fenris is destined to devour Wotan at Ragnarok.

deity.name: Frigg
deity.title: Queen of the Aesir
entries: Frigg is the goddess of marriage and prophecy, and she counts many prophets and diviners among her faithful. The wife of Wotan and mother of Baldur and Hodr, she is the patron of households and hearths but also witches. Frigg stands proud, neither bending a knee to her husband nor allowing him to dictate her actions, a fact he adores.

deity.name: Heimdall
deity.title: Eternal Guardian
entries: Heimdall is the god of watchfulness and loyalty, who guards the Bifrost and the Gates of Asgard. He is well-suited to the task, for his senses are amazingly keen. He can see a hundred miles in both daylight and darkest night, hear grass growing, and feel the footfall of an ant. He is the patron of the besieged, popular all along the Reaver Coast, as well as with scouts, lookouts, and those who guard treasuries and grain stores.

deity.name: Hodr
deity.title: Blind Bringer of Darkness and Twilight
entries: Hodr is the brother of Baldur and son of Wotan and Frigg. He is thought to be a reflection of his brother, and he stands as the god of darkness and winter twilights. Though not an evil god, he is a tragic one. Born blind, he possesses immense strength, rivaling that of Thor. He is destined to be tricked by Loki into accidentally killing his brother at the beginning of Ragnarok.

deity.name: Idun
deity.title: Keeper of the Apples
entries: The goddess of spring and renewal tends the apples of eternal youth, which allow the gods to remain immortal. She is the wife of Bragi, the god of poetry. Though she has the pleasant demeanor of a fresh-faced maiden, Idun has a keen eye for mischief-makers who would steal from her orchard.

deity.name: Hel
deity.title: The Queen of Helheim
entries: The daughter of Loki and sister of Fenris and Jormungandr, Hel presides over the dead who are not valorous enough to be granted a place in Valhalla or Folkvangr. She is fated to aid her father by bringing the shades of her dead against the gods at Ragnarok.

deity.name: Jormungandr
deity.title: The World Serpent
entries: One of Loki's monstrous children, Jormungandr encircles the world, containing creation within the ring formed by the beast taking its own tail in its jaws. The Midgard Serpent is fated to battle Thor to the death at Ragnarok.

deity.name: Nidhogg
deity.title: First Dragon and Chewer of the World Tree
entries: Coiled around its treasure hoard of grave goods and sacrifices hidden among the roots of Yggdrasil, Nidhogg desires only power, chaos, and apocalypse. Those who've dared look into the Ur-dragon's golden eyes claim that all the secrets of the void can be glimpsed in their maddening depths.

deity.name: Skadi
deity.title: Mistress of Winter Wildlands
altNames: Goddess and Patron of Hunters, Archers, and Skiers
entries: The giant Skadi became one of the Aesir upon her marriage to Njord, the sea god. This was compensation for the murder of her father, the jotun Thiazi. As wergild, Skadi could choose a god of the Aesir to be her husband but only by looking at their feet. Before she chose, she assumed the nicest feet would belong to Baldur, the most beautiful of the gods. However, when she judged the feet she saw and selected the nicest ones, they actually belonged to Njord, the sea god. Their marriage was not a success and now they live separate lives.

monster.name: Brunnmigi
languages: understands Common and the Northern Tongue but cannot speak

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brunnmigi makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 2 Poison damage.

action.name: Befouled Spittle
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. The target can make a save whenever it completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} to end this condition.

spellcasting.name: Inflame Greed
headerEntries: Fafnir casts {@spell Compel Avarice|NorthlandsWorldbook}, requiring no Material components or {@status Concentration|XPHB} and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}). Fafnir cannot take this action again until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Armor of Greed (3/Day)
entries: When Fafnir is hit by attack, he can choose for the attack to miss instead. If the attack is a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, he must spend two uses of this trait to cause it to miss. Each time Fafnir uses this ability, creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against him until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Aura of Avarice
entries: Creatures within 1 mile of Fafnir's lair have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saves against spells and effects that compel them to take or steal things, and they feel deeply protective of their own belongings and covetous of the belongings of others.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If Fafnir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three attacks using Bite or Constrict in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18} One Huge or smaller creature Fafnir can see within 10 feet of him. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) and the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the Grapple ends. Fafnir can only grapple one creature at a time with this ability.

action.name: Misfortune Breath {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 7d8}) Poison damage, and the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} until the end of Fafnir's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

legendary.name: Toxic Blood Spray
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17} Each creature within 20 feet of Fafnir. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 4d4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of the target's next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Fafnir cannot take this action again until the start of his next turn. Fafnir can only use this ability if he's missing at least one of its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

legendary.name: Entrap
entries: Fafnir moves up to half his {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and makes one Constrict attack.

trait.name: Ancient Imprisonment
entries: Rage and terror at Nidhogg's imprisonment by Wotan reverberates down the generations within his brood. When rolling saves against effects that cause the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition, as well as any that would entrap it, the Nidhogg spawn drake has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drake makes one Bite and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the drake's next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Venom Spit {@recharge 4}
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 30/60 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 4d6 + 2}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Earth Wyrm
entries: The drake burrows 20 feet.

monster.name: Eikthyrnir
languages: Understands Common, Dwarven, Elvish, and the Northern Tongue, but cannot speak

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d12 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Necrotic damage. If the target is Huge or smaller, and the eikthyrnir moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

bonus.name: Grasping Thorns
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15} A Large or smaller creature within 30 feet is pulled adjacent to the eikthyrnir and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (Escape {@dc 15}). While {@condition Grappled|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

monster.name: Fenrikyn
languages: Understands Abyssal and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Mystical Chain
entries: The mystical chain attached to the fenrikyn is its greatest weakness and can be severed by an attack dealing 20 Slashing damage against AC 17, which deals no damage to the fenrikyn. If the fenrikyn's chain is destroyed, it takes 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. It also loses its Chain Attack action, Whirling Chain action, and Deflecting Chain Reaction.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fenrikyn makes one Bite attack and one Chain attack. If its Mystical Chain has been broken, it instead makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Chain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}). While grappled, the target cannot move further than 20 feet from the fenrikyn, and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet.

action.name: Whirling Chain {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} All creatures within 20 feet of the fenrikyn. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target is pushed or pulled 10 feet. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Deflecting Chain
entries: {@actTrigger} The fenrikyn is hit by an attack. {@actResponse} The fenrikyn adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monster.name: Fleshcrawler
languages: Telepathy 120 ft. (can communicate only with other fleshcrawlers or infected creatures)

trait.name: Infect Humanoid
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 15} A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} in a fleshcrawler's fleshwebs for 1 hour. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for {@dice 1d4} days. While a creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition in this way, the fleshcrawler can issue telepathic instructions that the creature does its best to obey. If it completes an order and doesn't receive further direction from the fleshcrawler, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition on a success. A creature with the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition can make a save to end the effect at the end of each day.
If a creature is still {@condition Charmed|XPHB} at the end of the duration, it dies, and its body transforms into a flesh cocoon gestating a new fleshcrawler that hatches in 1 hour.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fleshcrawler makes two attacks, using Fleshwarp Strike and Necrotic Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Fleshwarp Strike
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Necrotic damage and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} target rolls a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 15}) to end this condition.

action.name: Necrotic Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Fleshwebs {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15} One creature the fleshcrawler can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 15; HP 15; {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage).

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The fossegrim can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The fossegrim has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The fossegrim casts one of the following spells with its musical instrument, but requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

spellcasting.name: Illusory Appearance
headerEntries: The fossegrim casts {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}. It can appear as a Small or Medium Humanoid.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fossegrim makes two Discordant Chord attacks.

action.name: Discordant Chord
entries: {@atkr m,s} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 feet, one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Thunder damage.

action.name: Torrential Tune (2/day)
entries: The Fossegrim plays its musical instrument, conjuring a wave of water to crash down upon its enemies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 15} All creatures in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Bewildering Harmonics
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15} One creature the fossegrim can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target becomes confused until the end of its next turn. The target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} and must roll {@dice 1d8} to determine what it does on its next turn:

items: 1-4. The target does nothing.
5-6. The target takes no action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and uses all its movement to move in a random direction.
7-8. The target makes a melee attack against a random creature within its reach, or it does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

bonus.name: Ventriloquistic Step
entries: The fossegrim teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Cacophonous Note {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature succeeds on a d20 Test within 30 feet of the fossegrim. {@actResponse} The creature must roll again and take the new result.

trait.name: Maggoty Hide
entries: A creature attacking the garmr in melee that is adjacent to the garmr is subject to the maggots crawling over its rank fur. {@actSave dex} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested with maggots, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage at the beginning of each of its turns. An infested target can make another saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect, and the maggots are burnt away if it takes at least 5 Acid or Fire damage. After the creature successfully saves or the maggots are burnt away, it has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to this trait for 1 hour.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The garmr has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the garmr's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The garmr makes two bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Earth Rending Howl {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 5d6}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. Unattended objects and structures in the area are not allowed a saving throw, they take double damage, and the howl ignores their damage threshold.

bonus.name: Rotten Shake {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 13} Each creature within 5 feet of the garmr. {@actSaveFail} The target is infested with maggots (see Maggoty Hide).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the jotun fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The jotun has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Material Bound
entries: The jotun has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to any spell or effect that would force it to leave the Material Plane, unless the jotun wants to leave. It has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws against effects that would return it to the Material Plane from another plane of existence.

trait.name: Too Big to Notice
entries: While the jotun remains motionless in nonmagical, natural terrain, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The jotun casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jotun makes three Greatclub or Rock attacks in any combination. Instead of one of those attacks, it can use Icy Sweep or cast Fear.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 17} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage plus 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Icy Sweep {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 23} Each creature within 20 feet of the jotun. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Bludgeoning damage and 54 ({@damage 12d8}) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the jotun and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Rock Catching
entries: {@actTrigger} The jotun is hit by a ranged weapon attack. {@actResponse} The jotun reduces the damage by {@dice 1d20 + 30}. If this reduces the damage to 0, the jotun can throw the weapon or ammunition at a creature within 60 feet of it, using the same attack roll total and damage total of the originating creature.

legendary.name: Hurl
entries: The jotun makes a Rock attack.

legendary.name: Smash
entries: The jotun makes a Greatclub attack.

legendary.name: Titanic Power
entries: The jotun casts a spell or uses Icy Sweep, if available.

trait.name: Electrifying Flesh
entries: A lightning giant's flesh constantly sparks with electricity. A creature striking a lightning giant with a melee weapon must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Lightning damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d10}) damage if the weapon is made out of a conductive metal such as iron. A lightning giant can suppress this ability with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lightning giant makes two attacks, using Lightning Staff or Static Fling in any combination.

action.name: Lightning Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Static Fling
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Lightning damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet.

action.name: Static Discharge (Recharge 6 or Special)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15} All creatures in a 20-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} surrounding the lightning giant. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Lightning Damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Absorb Lightning
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the lightning giant can see within 60 feet (other than itself) deals Lightning damage to a creature other than the lightning giant. {@actResponse} The lightning giant absorbs the Lightning damage into its staff, negating that damage against its original target. This also recharges its Static Discharge ability.

trait.name: Ever Vigilant
entries: At least two of the thrudgelmir's heads are awake at all times. The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The thrudgelmir has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Runic Tattoos
entries: The thrudgelmir giant's body is covered in magical, runic tattoos. A successful {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} cast on the tattoos (against {@dc 15}) causes them to vanish for 1 minute. During that time, the thrudgelmir loses its Magic Resistance and the energy damage from its Elemental Hammer attack.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The thrudgelmir makes three Elemental Hammer attacks.

action.name: Elemental Hammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d8 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) damage (roll {@dice 1d6} to determine damage type: 1. Acid, 2. Cold, 3. Fire, 4. Lightning, 5. Poison, 6. Thunder).

action.name: Faces of Evil {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 16}. {@actSaveFail} All creatures within 30 feet of the thrudgelmir that can see it are subjected to one of the following conditions or effects until the end of the giant's next turn.

rows: {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}
The creature sees allies as enemies and the thrudgelmir as an ally

trait.name: Cast Iron Stomach
entries: Thursir have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Thurs Rune Warhammer
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Lightning damage, and the target can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions} until the start of the giant's next turn.

action.name: Rock
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Arctic Camouflage
entries: The tundra gnoll has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks in snowy or icy conditions.

action.name: Bone Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Bone Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d10 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Freezing Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12} One creature within 20 feet of the tundra gnoll. {@actSaveFail} The creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 feet until the end of its next turn by a supernatural chill.

bonus.name: Rampage (2/Day)
entries: Immediately after dealing damage to a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} creature, the tundra gnoll moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and makes one Bone Axe attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The grendelkyn can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Shadow Armor
entries: The grendelkyn is surrounded by a writhing mantle of shadows. This mantle adds 3 to its AC (included in its stats) and grants it {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} or {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the grendelkyn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls, and it loses its Shadow Armor. Additionally, it cannot use its Shadow Snare Action, and any existing Shadow Snare melts.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The grendelkyn makes one Bite and one Claws attack. It can replace its Claws attack with Shadow Snare.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Piercing damage. On a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of the grendelkyn's next turn.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shadow Snare
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage, and the target is wrapped in shadowy tendrils extending from the grendelkyn's body, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions. A creature can make a new Dexterity Saving Throw at the end of each of its turns to free itself. Otherwise, it remains ensnared by the tendrils for 1 minute. The Shadow Snare also vanishes if it is exposed to sunlight, the grendelkyn dies or has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, or it chooses to use Shadow Snare against a new target.

bonus.name: Shadow Port
entries: A grendelkyn in an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. If the grendelkyn teleports while it has a creature trapped in a Shadow Snare, that creature also teleports 30 feet, to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the grendelkyn that is in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}. If no such space is available, the grendelkyn releases the trapped creature when it teleports.

reaction.name: Frenzied Shriek
entries: {@actTrigger} The grendelkyn is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}. {@actResponse} All creatures within 20 feet of the grendelkyn make a {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature affected by the shriek can make a new Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect on itself.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hafgufa can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Seagoing Lurker
entries: The hafgufa has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Stealth|XPHB} checks when underwater.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The hafgufa deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hafgufa makes four Tentacle attacks. It can replace one attack with its Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) Piercing damage. The hafgufa has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this attack roll against a creature grappled by one of its tentacles.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 18}) from one of four tentacles, and the hafgufa can pull the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Reeking Mist {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17} Each creature in a 40-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes. At the end of each of its turns, a target can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on a success.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18} One Large or smaller creature within 5 feet that is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by the hafgufa (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed, and the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, it has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the hafgufa, and it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the hafgufa's turns.

If the hafgufa takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the hafgufa must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the hafgufa and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. If the hafgufa dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The hafgufa spawn can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Seagoing Lurker
entries: The hafgufa spawn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Stealth|XPHB} checks when underwater.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hafgufa spawn makes four Tentacle attacks. It can replace one attack with Bite.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Piercing damage. The hafgufa spawn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this attack roll against a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by one of its tentacles.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}) from one of four tentacles, and the hafgufa spawn can pull the target up to 10 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Reeking Mist (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube}. {@actSaveFail} Target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition for 10 minutes. At the end of each of its turns, a target can repeat the saving throw, ending the condition on a success.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hamingja has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hamingja casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}):

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Radiant Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hamingja shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or smaller Beast or Humanoid. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} is only available in its true form or a form possessing wings. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

reaction.name: Shot of Luck (3/day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the hamingja is bonded to fails an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. {@actResponse} The creature adds {@dice 1d6} to its die roll, potentially turning the failure into a success.

monster.name: Jorumungkyn
languages: Understands Draconic but can't speak it.

trait.name: Poisonous Secretions
entries: The jorumungkyn constantly oozes poison into its surroundings. A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of a jorumungkyn (or 30 feet in water) takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The jorumungkyn makes one Bite attack and one Tail attack and uses Constrict.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19} One Huge or smaller creature the jorumungkyn can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage. The target has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}) and has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the Grapple ends.

bonus.name: Glare of the Deep (2/Day)
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 14} One creature within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If the target is more than 5 feet from the jorumungkyn, the target moves on its turn toward the jorumungkyn by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the jorumungkyn. Before moving into damaging terrain and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the jorumungkyn, the target repeats the save. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the jorumungkyn's Glare of the Deep for 24 hours.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The sea lindwurm can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sea lindwurm makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Piercing damage. The target is also subject to the sea lindwurm's paralyzing toxin. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@b First Failure:} The creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it's still {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@b Second Failure:} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.

action.name: Flipper Slap {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} All creatures in a 10-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} around the sea lindwurm. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Deep Dive
entries: The sea lindwurm moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without drawing {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

trait.name: Bristles
entries: A creature that hits the malrgotr with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The malrgotr makes one Gore attack and one Hooves attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Glorious Flare {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} All creatures in a 15-foot radius around the malrgotr. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Massive Frame
entries: The great ogre has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength saving throws and Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The great ogre makes two greatclub attacks or throws two javelins.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 4d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 50/200 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Hideous Belch {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} All creatures in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage, and the creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. A creature with the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect upon itself.

reaction.name: Tense Muscles {@recharge 6}
entries: {@actTrigger} The great ogre is hit by an attack that deals Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Piercing damage. {@actResponse} The great ogre takes half damage from the triggering attack.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The runewright has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The runewright casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The runewright casts the {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} spell.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The runewright makes three Rune Blast attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Runic Gaze.

action.name: Rune Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Radiant damage (the runewright's choice based on the rune being used).

action.name: Runic Gaze
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} One creature the runewright can see with 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition (the runewright's choice) until the start of the runewright's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: Sun Rune
entries: {@actTrigger} The runewright is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The attacking creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Fey Resilience
entries: The selkie has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} conditions.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The selkie can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Speak with Pinnipeds
entries: The selkie can communicate with seals, sea lions, and walruses as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The selkie makes one Bite attack and two Tail attacks, or it makes three Spear attacks.

action.name: Bite (Seal Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 +2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Spear (Fey Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Tail (Seal Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

bonus.name: Change Shape
entries: The selkie magically transforms into a Medium seal or back into its true form, which is Fey. Its statistics, other than its AC, size, and {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying transforms with it. It reverts to its true form if it dies. If the selkie is in its true form, it can't use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} unless it is wearing or carrying its bound sealskin.

bonus.name: Charming Escape
entries: The selkie takes the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} action. Each creature within 5 feet of a selkie when it takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} Action in this way must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The creature has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of the selkie's next turn.

trait.name: Fate's Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the skein witch fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The skein witch has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skein witch makes three Inexorable Thread attacks.

action.name: Inexorable Thread
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d8 + 5}) Radiant damage. If the skein witch hits with this attack, it can teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

action.name: Destiny Distortion Wave {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} Each creature of its choice in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 55 Force damage, and the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for 1 minute. A creature can make a save at the end of each of its turns to end this effect. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: Bind Fates (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17} One creature the skein witch can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target's fate is bound to that of one of its allies of the witch's choice. Any damage or condition the target suffers is inflicted on the ally to which it is bound instead, and vice versa. A creature can be bound to only one other creature at a time. This binding lasts until lifted by a {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB}, {@spell Heal|XPHB}, or {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

bonus.name: Cutting the Thread
entries: The skein witch chooses a creature within 30 feet of it that it can see and that is at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If the creature was {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}, it is no longer {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}. In addition, it must make an immediate {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}.

reaction.name: Parry Spell
entries: {@actTrigger} The skein witch succeeds on a saving throw against a spell of 4th level or lower that targets only the skein witch. {@actResponse} The spell has no effect. If the skein witch succeeds on the saving throw by 5 or more, the spell is reflected back at the spellcaster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The skeljaskra deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skeljaskra makes two attacks, using Rend, Burning Spit, or Tail in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Burning Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 30 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d8 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet.

reaction.name: Armored Ball
entries: {@actTrigger} The skeljaskra takes 10 or more Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from a single source. {@actResponse} The skeljaskra curls into a ball until the start of its next turn. While this effect lasts, the creature has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The dread skeljaskra deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dread skeljaskra makes two attacks, using Rend, Burning Spit, or Spiked Tail in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 6d8 + 6}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Burning Spit
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10} to hit, range 90 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Poison damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions until the start of the skeljaskra's next turn.

action.name: Spiked Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}33 ({@damage 5d10 + 6}) Piercing damage, and the target is pushed 20 feet.

action.name: Crushing Roll {@recharge 5}
entries: If the dread skeljaskra begins its turn in its Armored Ball form, it can roll up to 60 feet. {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} Each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that is 15 feet wide. {@actSaveFail} 32 ({@damage 5d12}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

reaction.name: Armored Ball
entries: {@actTrigger} The dread skeljaskra takes 30 or more damage. {@actResponse} The skeljaskra curls into a ball until the start of its next turn. While this effect lasts, the creature has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The skogsra casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The skogsra makes three Claw attacks. In place of one Claw attack, it can use Grasping Vines or Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Grasping Vines
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15} One Medium or smaller creature the skogsra can see within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled up to 10 feet toward the skogsra and has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 15}).

bonus.name: Hollow Trap
entries: The skogsra pulls a creature with the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition into its hollow body. While held in this way, the target isn't {@condition Grappled|XPHB} but has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions, and it takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Slashing damage and 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage reduces a Humanoid creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, that creature is considered {@variantrule Stable|XPHB} and has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition. This condition lasts for 12 hours or until the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} creature regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

The held creature has {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the skogsra. While holding a creature within its body, the skogsra can't pull another creature into its hollow.

If the skogsra takes 15 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate that creature, which falls in a space within 5 feet of the skogsra and has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

If the skogsra dies, a held creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} or {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: The fjord troll can hold its breath for 30 minutes.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The fjord troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fjord troll makes two Gouge attacks.

action.name: Gouge
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Water Stream
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14} Each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Cold damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is pushed up to 10 feet away from the fjord troll. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Aquatic Charge
entries: The fjord troll swims up to half its {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB}.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The gilitrutt troll regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gilitrutt troll makes two Bite or three Claw attacks.

action.name: Bite (Hound Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Claw (Troll Form Only)
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The gilitrutt troll shape-shifts into a Large hound ({@variantrule Speed|XPHB} 40 ft.), or it returns to its troll form. Its game statistics, other than its size and {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}, are the same in each form (except where noted). Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Frigid Aura
entries: Nonmagical flames within 15 feet of the troll are snuffed out. Ongoing magical flames, such as those from a {@spell Flaming Sphere|XPHB} or {@spell Wall of Fire|XPHB} spell, also have a chance of being snuffed out. If any part of such a magical flame overlaps with the aura, the caster must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. {@actSaveFail} The spell ends. If the caster succeeds on the save, they do not need to make additional saves for that casting of that spell.

trait.name: Icy Carapace
entries: A creature within 5 feet of the troll that hits it with a melee attack takes 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The glacial troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the glacial troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the glacial troll's next turn. The glacial troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The glacial troll makes three Ice Rend attacks. It can substitute one Ice Rend attack with its Hoary Breath.

action.name: Ice Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Hoary Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16} One target within 5 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 3d6}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition for 1 minute due to ice forming around it. A creature with the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition can make a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns to break free from the ice, ending the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The wind troll regains 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Storm Absorption
entries: Whenever the wind troll is subjected to Lightning or Thunder damage, it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Lightning and Thunder damage dealt.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The wind troll casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The wind troll makes three attacks, using Rend or Storm Strike in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Storm Strike
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 feet, one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Lightning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Thunder damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

action.name: Windstorm {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15} Each creature in a 20-foot radius around the troll. {@actSaveFail} 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from the troll. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Flying Charge
entries: The wind troll flies up to half its {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}.

monster.name: Buried Lord Vaettir
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Aura of Authority
entries: While in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the buried lord, the buried lord's allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the buried lord doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

trait.name: Grave Goods Sense
entries: The buried lord can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættr's personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættr can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed buried lord vættr gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn't function if the vættr is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the buried lord vaettir has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The buried lord vaettir casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

spellcasting.name: Hunter (2/Day)
headerEntries: The buried lord vaettir casts {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The buried lord vaettir makes two Longsword or two Longbow attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4} to hit, range 150/600 feet., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Corpse Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13} Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Disorienting Gaze
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13} One creature the buried lord can see within 30 feet of it. {@actSaveFail} For 1 minute, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and moves in a random direction whenever it moves. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveSuccess} The target has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to this buried lord's Disorienting Gaze for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The buried lord vaettir is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon or shield. {@actResponse} The buried lord vaettir adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monster.name: Drowned Raider Vaettir
languages: The languages it knew in life

trait.name: Grave Goods Sense
entries: The drowned raider vættir can pinpoint the location of creatures wearing or carrying one of the vættr's personal items or grave goods within 60 feet of it, and the vættr can sense the general direction of its personal items and grave goods within 1 mile of it.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: A destroyed drowned raider vættir gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and becoming active again. The new body forms in a random unoccupied space within 100 feet of where it fell. This trait doesn't function if the vættir is put to rest (typically by returning its remains to its burial mound).

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drowned raider vaettir has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drowned raider vaettir makes two attacks using Battleaxe or Javelin in any combination.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Water Purge
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12} Each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

monster.name: Vedaja
languages: Understands the language of its creator plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: A vedaja's form can't be altered.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The vedaja has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vedaja makes two Hand attacks.

action.name: Hand
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (the vedaja's choice).

action.name: Terrifying Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11} One creature the vedaja can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of the vedaja's next turn. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition.

monster.name: Andahestur
languages: Understands Celestial and the Northern Tongue but cannot speak.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Divine Strike (3/day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The andahestur hits with a Hoof attack. {@actResponse} The Andahestur adds 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage to the triggering attack.

trait.name: Forest Walker
entries: While in forest terrain, the moose has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) checks.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.
