A stranger in a tattered cloak stands in the shadows watching you with a single gleaming eye
You find a small stone with a pattern not unlike a rune scratched upon it by an unknown hand.
A bright, fiery light burns itself across the sky, heading North.
Behold! The Bifrost shimmers in the night sky!

table.name: Foreboding Omens
rows: Three hawks moving in unison watch you with red eyes.
A chill fog reaches tendrils of mist toward you like cadaverous arms.
An owl swoops low overhead and drops a broken elm twig at your feet.
The sound of a child's laugh, or perhaps a cry, echoes through the night.
The breeze carries the unmistakable stench of burning flesh and sickly rot.
A vast shadow follows you beneath the waves (or across the land).
A sudden powerful breeze makes you stumble. Then all is still.
Distant yet thunderous footsteps shakes the ground.
A black fox steps into view ahead then is snatched away in an instant by a huge bird
Oddly flickering lights drift beneath the surface of the water.
No one else seems to notice how the sun dims as if struggling to remain alight.
Your shadow distorts, forming into monstrous shapes before settling back to normal.

table.name: Mysterious Omens
rows: The shadow of one tree falls in a different direction than the trees around it.
The moon flickers like a torch for a moment before settling back into its usual place.
The air bears the scent of the sea, though the coast is far away.
A shadow passes overhead, yet no bird or beast is in the sky.
A single sharp animal tooth stands upright, stuck into the ground, but no beast is nearby.
The ground rumbles faintly, and in its grumbling can be heard sounds that seem like words.
An unseen bird sings a mournful song that echoes in the forest.
Your own pouch rests on the path ahead, otherwise untouched and undisturbed.
A faint rune appears on a nearby surface, but it is gone when you look closer.
A flock of birds bursts out of cover, momentarily forming a rune-like pattern before dispersing.
The nearby water ripples as if disturbed, but nothing appears to have caused it.

table.name: Raiding Targets (Abstracted)
rows: Clothing, foodstuffs, grain, light armor, livestock, Simple weapons, tools, vegetables
Amber, furs/skins, herbs, spices, textiles, trade goods, tools
{@item Potion of Gealing|XPHB|Healing Potions}, illuminated manuscripts, jeweled holy symbols, medicinal supplies, religious texts, reliquaries, {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG|Spell Scrolls}
Academic texts, art or decorative works, scribing supplies, {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG|Spell Scrolls}
Foodstuffs, horses, Martial weapons, Medium armor, metal bars, {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields}, smithing supplies, tools
As hamlet plus {@filter Common magic items|items|rarity=common}, furniture, furs, gems (limited supply), leather goods, smithing supplies, trade goods
As village plus coins (silver), glassware, herbs/medical supplies, manuscripts or books, textiles, {@filter Uncommon magic items|items|rarity=uncommon}, wine
As small town plus fine furniture, luxury goods (gems, silks, spices, etc.), metalwork, Rare magic items, supply caches

As large town plus exotic luxury goods (ivory, rare woods, items from monster parts, etc.), finest household items, jeweled religious items, manuscripts and records, quality arms and armor, rare horses and livestock, stores of provisions, {@filter Very Rare magic items|items|rarity=very rare}
As city plus finest arms and armor, medical supplies, rare horses or monstrous mounts, siege weapons, stores of provisions, treasury
footnotes: {@sup *} Added to the price each PC pays at the end of the Preparation Phase

table.name: Ship Upgrades
rows: Gain one reroll of the result in the journey or return phase
Reduce the increased travel time after a storm in the journey/return phase by half
Reduce the penalty by 1 for losing crew in the journey/return phase
Negate the monster attack event in the journey/return phase
Negate the time penalty from storms in the journey/return phase
Reduce time in the journey/return phase by {@dice 1d4} days
Reduce time in the journey/return phase by {@dice 1d4} days
Reduce time in the journey/return phase by {@dice 1d4} days
Negate the loss of spoils from the pirate event in the journey/return phase
footnotes: {@sup *}Added to the price each PC pays at the end of the preparation phase

table.name: Extra Warriors
footnotes: {@sup *} Total is added to the price each PC pays at the end of the preparation phase

table.name: Special Resources
rows: Larger round shields; +1 to raiding roll
Negates a Frozen in Ice event in the journey/return phase
Negates a Spoiled Supplies event in the journey/return phase
Alchemical fire weapon; +2 to raiding roll
Aids in perception; +1 to spoils dice result
Aids in finding hidden metals; +2 to spoils dice result
Usable at the start of the raid phase; allows you to reroll the raid roll once. You must use the new result even if it's worse
If the spoils die roll is the lowest possible result, add +1 to the die
Negates the Lost! event in the journey/return phase

table.name: Sea/Land Journey
rows: Travel time increases by {@dice 1d10} days; crew impatient, –1 to spoils die
Lose some crew defeating monster; –1 to raiding roll
Many perish from intense cold; –2 to raiding roll
Many warriors fall ill; –1 to raiding roll, –1 to spoils die
Lose some crew fending off the pirates; –1 to raiding roll
Reduce travel time by {@dice 2d4} days, crew well-fed by fish
Crew inspired by dream of heroes and glory; {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on raiding roll.

table.name: Raiding Roll
rows: Lost over half the warriors; return phase rolls have Dis{@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}; return phase takes an extra week.
Heavy casualties; return phase takes an extra week.
Important NPC taken captive or {@filter Uncommon magic item|items|rarity=uncommon} found
Important NPC taken captive or {@filter Rare magic item|items|rarity=rare} found
Add the maximum possible result of the spoils die as a bonus to the spoils die roll.

baseitem.name: Seax
entries: These fighting knives are too heavy to be thrown, but they boast long blades that can punch through leather and mail.

baseitem.name: Snaerispear
entries: These short, javelin-like spears can be hurled great distances by means of a "throwing string," a leather strap affixed to the mid-point of the spear shaft. This allows the snaerispear to deal more damage when thrown than in melee.

baseitem.name: Atgeir
entries: A polearm with a large, single-edged blade attached along the side of the haft. Atgeirs are thrusting weapons often used to lever enemies out of position after they have been struck.

baseitem.name: Bearded Axe
entries: The hook-shaped "beard" at the lower edge of the head of a bearded axe gives it its characteristic silhouette and provides a larger cutting edge than standard battle axes without excessively increasing its weight.

baseitem.name: Breidox
entries: Essentially a greataxe with a longer haft, the breidox was developed to deliver a powerful slash to opponents behind a protective shield wall.

baseitem.name: Bryntroll
entries: A massive chopping blade mounted at the end of a long pole, the bryntroll is designed to pierce the tough hides of giants.

baseitem.name: Walrus Hide
entries: These thick, treated walrus hide suits are flexible but quite heavy. In addition to its defensive benefits, walrus hide counts as winter clothing when determining the effects of {@hazard Extreme Cold|XDMG}.

baseitem.name: Hardened Mail Shirt
entries: This chain shirt has rings of adamantine or mithral woven into key areas to provide more protection than normal mail.

baseitem.name: Beinagrind
entries: This armor is formed by carving disks or short shingles out of whale or giant bones and lacing them to a backing of flexible leather.

baseitem.name: Double Mail
entries: Also called tvifold brynja, the rings of this chain mail are doubled, so each pair is passed through by four pairs of other rings. It is very heavy and bulky.

baseitem.name: Jotunskull Helm
entries: Favored by those who wish to project a fearsome aspect, these helms are fashioned from the cleaned bones of a sufficiently large giant. When you wear one, you have Advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) checks against Giants (at the GM's discretion).

baseitem.name: Skates
entries: While wearing skates, you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} from slippery ice and automatically pass Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks to avoid have the {@condition Prone} condition on ice. You move at double your normal {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} while on ice, but you have a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 5 feet off the ice.

baseitem.name: Skis
entries: While wearing skis, you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} from deep snow and move at double your normal {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} while going downhill in snow. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saves and checks while wearing skis, except those related to moving through snow.

baseitem.name: Snow Goggles
entries: These thick glasses are set with lenses of smoky glass, preventing snow blindness.

baseitem.name: Snow Visor
entries: These thick bone or wood visors are bound to the head and are constructed with a narrow slit for the wearer's eyes. Creatures wearing snow visors have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to snow blindness but have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks relating to sight.

baseitem.name: Snowshoes
entries: While wearing snowshoes, you can ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} from deep snow. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saves and checks while wearing snowshoes.

baseitem.name: Talharpa
entries: A musical instrument with two to four strings similar to a lyre and played with a bow.

item.name: Antlered Headband of Chernobog
item.reqAttune: by a Bard, Paladin, Sorcerer, or Warlock
entries: Bone-white antlers, the tips stained with dried blood, are mounted on a tanned leather headband stained with the black ichor that oozes from the bases of the antlers.
While wearing this headband, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Devil's Sight
entries: You can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}—both magical and nonmagical—within {@b 120 feet} of yourself.

entries.name: Antler Charge
entries: You can make a melee weapon attack with the antlers. Add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and your Strength modifier to the attack roll. The antlers deal {@damage 1d10} Piercing damage plus your Strength modifier. The antlers have the {@itemMastery Push|XPHB} Weapon Mastery property, and you get it for free (with the antlers only) if you do not have access to Weapon Mastery as a class feature. If you have Weapon Mastery as a class feature, you can use Push with the antlers. If you do, you push creatures hit by your attacks with the antlers 15 feet instead of 10 feet.

If you move at least 15 feet in a straight line before dealing damage to a creature with the antlers, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The headband has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it using your spell save DC: {@spell Darkness|XPHB} (1 charge), {@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB} (3 charges). You can target Undead creatures with this use of {@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB}, even if they ordinarily have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to it.

item.name: Arm Ring of Self-Sacrifice
entries: This arm ring is mildly painful to wear. This arm ring has {@b 5 charges} and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While you are wearing it, you can use its charges as follows:

entries.name: Aggressive Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can expend {@b 2 charges} to deal maximum damage with the attack. However, you also take Force damage equal to the minimum possible damage of the attack, and you cannot reduce or mitigate this damage in any way.

entries.name: Redirection
entries: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll against an ally within {@b 5 feet} of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and expend {@b 1 charge} to become the target of the attack instead.

item.name: Bell-Ringing Greatclub
entries: This Greatclub is fashioned from the clapper of a giant's bell. When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with this Greatclub, you can choose for the target to have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn instead of dealing the extra damage from the {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}.

item.name: Belt of the Berserker
item.reqAttune: by a Barbarian with the Reckless Attack Class Feature
entries: While wearing this wolf-hide belt, you can choose to use the following feature each time you activate your Rage class feature:

entries.name: Foolhardy Rage
entries: While you are Raging, you gain an extra {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} each turn that you can only use to extend your Rage or to take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action. If you use it to take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, you cannot take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action again on that turn. In addition, you gain a +1 Bonus to your Rage Damage. Finally, you must use your Reckless Attack Class feature on each of your turns during your Rage, or your Rage ends.

item.name: Berserker's Mead
entries: For 1 minute after you consume this potion, you are {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immune} to the first 40 points of damage you take.

item.name: Bygul's Paw Boots
entries: These fluffy boots have wide soles and sharp spikes along the front that act as crampons. While wearing the boots, you can move through {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by snow or ice without expending additional movement, automatically pass Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) checks to avoid having the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks to climb. While wearing the boots your footprints resemble those of a large cat.

item.name: Cloak of Wide-Ranging
entries: While wearing this wolf-skin cloak, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws to avoid levels of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} after traveling for more than 8 hours in a day.

item.name: Arrow of Ice-Trapping
entries: This arrow deals an additional {@damage 1d6} Cold damage on a successful hit. If a creature takes damage from the ammunition, it must make a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition due to being trapped in bands of ice. It can make a save at the end of each of its turns to end the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. While it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition, the target takes {@damage 1d6} Cold damage at the start of each of its turns. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check to free it.

item.name: Defender Honey
entries: The honey is light brown and has a smooth sweetness. For {@b 10 minutes} after you consume this honey, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to put yourself between an attack that would hit an ally within {@b 5 feet} of you. The attack targets you instead with the same attack roll.

item.name: Einherjar's Drinking Horn
entries: This ornately carved drinking horn has {@b 6 charges} and regains {@dice 1d6} charges each day at dawn. It appears empty, but the holder can expend a charge to take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and put it to their lips to drink a draught of delicious mead. Any creature drinking this mead is invigorated, gaining enough nourishment to sustain it for a day. Alternatively, a creature can drink from the horn as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and expend {@b 6 charges} to gain the same benefits, and the horn removes 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} from that creature. A creature cannot benefit from this reduction in {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} more than two days in a row.

item.name: Feather Token (Raven)
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to throw this black token into the air. You can see and hear through the token for one hour. The token disappears afterwards or if the distance between you and it exceeds 1 mile. The bird has the statistics of a {@creature Raven|XMM}.

item.name: Feather Token (Snowy Owl)
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to wave this white and grey feather across a creature's face. For {@b 1 hour}, that creature can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action without the usual requirements of being Obscured or behind {@variantrule Cover|XPHB}, as long as it is against snowy terrain.

item.name: Glacierpress Boots
entries: The furry uppers of these boots have ice and gravel matted into them that never melts. These boots have {@b 3 charges} and regain {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend {@b 1 charge} to activate them for {@b 1 hour}. While the boots are active, you can move in a straight line through the space of any creature smaller than Huge. You do not provoke {@variantrule Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} due to this movement. The first time you enter a creature's space during this move, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be pushed ahead of you for the rest of your move.

item.name: Goggles of Snowsight
entries: While wearing these multifaceted blue crystal goggles, you do not have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks to see through areas that are {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} by blowing snow, sand, or other debris.

item.name: Goggles of Tracking
entries: These goggles have multiple lenses that can be swiveled. The goggles have {@b 3 charges}. While wearing the goggles, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend a charge. For {@b 1 hour}, you can see any tracks that were obscured by natural phenomena such as rain, snow, or blowing sand in the last week. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks to track creatures. The goggles regain {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Hel's Coin
entries: While carrying this blackened silver coin, if you fail a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}, you treat the save as a success instead. Then the coin crumbles into dust.

If you carry more than one Hel's Coin, you gain the following curse instead. If you succeed on a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}, you treat the success as a failure. Then one Hel's Coin crumbles to dust. This curse remains until there is only one coin left in your possession, whereupon that coin's normal effect resumes. You can freely divest yourself of extra coins.

item.name: Hjartarydi's Belt
entries: Touching this blood-red leather belt fills you with a sense of comfort. While you have the belt equipped, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

item.name: Hollow Eye
entries: This small wooden talisman is shaped like a large eyeball with an empty void in place of the pupil. While holding the eye, as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} to drip a small quantity of your own blood into the eye and cast either the {@spell Arcane Eye|XPHB} spell or the {@spell Divination|XPHB} spell. Once you use the eye once, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Honey of the Hearth Fire
entries: When you consume this honey, you end the {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Deafened|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, and {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} conditions on yourself.

item.name: Honey of the Hive Warden
entries: When you consume this honey, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Poison for {@b 1 hour}. Once during the duration, you may cast {@spell Insect Plague|XPHB} ({@dc 15}). Instead of locusts dealing Piercing damage, the spell creates bees that deal Poison damage.

item.name: Honey of the Norn-Blessed
entries: When you consume this honey, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws for {@b 1 hour}. Once during the duration, you may cast {@spell Augury|XPHB}.

item.name: Honey of Robust Health
entries: When you consume this honey as part of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can reroll any result of 1 or 2 on {@variantrule Hit Dice|XPHB} spent to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} during that rest. You must use the new roll. The honey has a deep red tinge and a rich flavor, and it warms the stomach.

item.name: Honey of the Sacred Bear
entries: When you consume this honey, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks for {@b 1 hour}. Once during the duration, you may cast {@spell Heroism|XPHB} on yourself, requiring no {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

item.name: Honey of the Skald's Tongue
entries: When you consume this honey, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Performance|XPHB} and {@skill Persuasion|XPHB} checks for {@b 1 hour}. Once during the duration, you may cast {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} ({@dc 15}).

item.name: Horn of Battle's Call
entries: This leather-wrapped horn is bound with stout iron bands. When you blow this horn as an action, choose up to five allies within {@b 120 feet} of you who can hear you. Each target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on melee weapon attacks until the start of your next turn and gains 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. The {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition ends on all targets. Once you blow the horn, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Horn of the Hrimthursar
entries: This ivory horn, also known as the Horn of Frozen Breath, is typically carved from the bone of a white dragon, remorhaz, or another arctic monster. When you sound the horn, it creates a blast of freezing wind in a {@b 60-foot} {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} takes {@damage 4d6} Cold damage and has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. A successful {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw halves the damage and negates the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. Once you blow the horn, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Horn of the Wild Hunt
entries: This black horn appears normal during daylight, but in darkness it glitters like a starlit sky. The horn has {@b 4 charges} and regains {@dice 1d4} charges daily at sunset.
When you blow this horn, you can expend {@b 1 charge} to cast {@spell Conjure Animals|XPHB}, or {@b 3 charges} to cast {@spell Conjure Fey|XPHB} (conjuring a spectral hunter).

item.name: Incendiary Coal
entries: This lump of coal is pleasingly warm to the touch. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you breathe gently into the coal to ignite it and can then throw it up to {@b 30 feet}, where it blossoms into a {@b 5-foot} {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} of fire.

A creature that ends its turn within or adjacent to the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 1d6} Fire damage on a failure and half as much on a success. Flammable objects in or adjacent to the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} that aren't being worn or carried start burning.

At the end of each of your subsequent turns, the size of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} increases by 5 feet, and the Fire damage dealt increases by {@damage 1d6} until it reaches its maximum size of 30 feet and maximum damage of {@damage 6d6}. At the end of each of your turns after that, the size of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} decreases by 5 feet, and the Fire damage dealt decreases by {@damage 1d6} until both reach 0, at which point the coal cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Iron Traitor's Arm Ring
entries: This arm ring has the rough appearance of hammered iron. You can take a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to swing the arm ring at a Huge or smaller creature within {@b 5 feet} of yourself.

Make a melee attack roll with an attack bonus equal to your Strength or Dexterity modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. On a hit, the arm ring coils around the target's arm, and the magical properties of magic items held or worn by the target cease to function until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to issue a command that releases the arm ring.

A creature that can touch the arm ring, including the one wearing it, can take an action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check to remove the arm ring. On a successful check, the item is removed, and the creature is freed from its effect. On a failed check, any further attempts made by that creature automatically fail until 24 hours have elapsed. The arm ring can also be removed if the limb is severed or if the ring is destroyed.
Once the arm ring is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Laekning Shield
entries: While holding this Shield, you have a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}. This round Shield magically repairs itself and is not destroyed at the end of an encounter where you are struck.

item.name: Mug of Friendship
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to enchant any potable liquid within this flagon. A creature that drinks the enchanted liquid is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks against it for {@b 1 hour}. After the hour is over, the creature is still {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly}, though its attitude can change based on your behavior.
After it has been used to enchant liquid once, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Nine-Escape Knot
entries: This one-foot-long rope of woven fox tails channels the power of the trickster Loki to escape difficult situations. While you hold it or have it on you, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks or saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} or {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Unraveling
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can unravel one of the nine knots in the rope to cast one of the following spells, using Charisma as your spellcasting ability: {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB}, {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Confusion|XPHB}, {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB}, {@spell Enthrall|XPHB}, {@spell Feign Death|XPHB}, {@spell Greater Invisibility|XPHB}, {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB}, and {@spell Misty Step|XPHB}. Each of these spells may be cast only once by the item. When the last knot is unraveled, the rope loses its magic.

item.name: Northlander's Boots
entries: The wearer of these furred boots can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to transform them into {@item Snowshoes|NorthlandsWorldbook}, {@item Skates|NorthlandsWorldbook|Ice Skates}, or {@item Skis|NorthlandsWorldbook}, and back again.

item.name: Ottaveggr Talharpa
entries: This Northlands Lyre is strung with cords made of braided jotun hair. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can play the talharpa to grant all your allies within {@b 60 feet} who can hear it {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and on Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) checks for {@b 1 hour}. Once this ability has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Potion of Near-Death Portent
entries: This potion's cloudy grey fluid has a golden thread suspended in it. Drinking this potion gives you a vague vision of your potential death. The next time within {@b 1 hour} that you would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and roll {@dice 1d20}. If the roll is 10 or higher, you take no damage. If the roll is less than 10, you are reduced to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead.

item.name: Ravenflight Axe
entries: When you attack a creature with this Handaxe and one of your allies is within {@b 5 feet} of the target, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage.

entries.name: Swarm Attack
entries: Once per day, you can release the weapon from your hand as an action, at which point it transforms into a {@b 60-foot} {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} of swarming ravens. Make a ranged weapon attack with the axe against each creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Immediately after completing the last attack, the weapon reappears in your hand. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Reaver's Lodestone
entries: This stone has a hole drilled through its center, through which runs a leather thong. One end of the stone has the rune for "person" etched into it, and the other bears the rune for "gold." The stone has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can spend {@b 1 charge} and whisper "person" or "gold" and dangle the stone from the thong.

When using the command "person," the stone orients and gently pulls toward some number of people. The strength of the pull is stronger when the targets are closer or higher in quantity. The range is 1 mile per gathering of 100 humanoid people, 10 miles for 1000 people, or 100 miles for 10,000 people. A gathering is a temporary or permanent living community, such as a hamlet, village, or town.

When using the command "gold," the stone orients and pulls you toward valuables. The strength of the pull is stronger when the targets are closer or more valuable. The range is 10 feet for coins or art objects worth a total of 100 GP, 100 feet for coins or art objects worth a total of 1000 GP, or 1000 feet for coins or art objects worth a total of 10,000 GP.
Whether you use it to find people or gold, it pulls you for 1 minute.

item.name: Ring of the Cragtop Jarl
entries: This polished granite ring bears runes of strength. While wearing the ring, when you attack with a weapon that deals Bludgeoning damage, you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a natural 19 or 20.
In addition, the ring has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.

entries.name: Bones of the Mountain
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} to cast {@spell False Life|XPHB}.

entries.name: Mountain Strike
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} when you deal Bludgeoning damage with a melee or ranged attack to push the target 10 feet.
Finally, it has the following property.

entries.name: Jarlpact Benefit
entries: If an ally within {@b 120 feet} is attuned to and wearing any other Ring of the Jarlpact, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

item.name: Ring of the Diving Bird
entries: While wearing this ring, you have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to any {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} you have.

item.name: Ring of the Forgefire Jarl
entries: This black iron ring bears glowing orange runes of fire and metal. While wearing the ring, your melee weapon attacks deal {@damage 1d6} extra Fire damage on a hit.
In addition, the ring has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.

entries.name: Furnace Blast
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} to cast {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} (level 4 version).

entries.name: Echo of the Forge
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} to cast {@spell Heat Metal|XPHB} (level 4 version).
Finally, it has the following property.

entries.name: Jarlpact Benefit
entries: If an ally within {@b 120 feet} is attuned to and wearing any other Ring of the Jarlpact, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

item.name: Ring of the Glacial Jarl
entries: This glittering ring of blue-white crystal bears runes of ice and battle. While wearing the ring, your melee weapon attacks deal {@damage 1d6} extra Cold Damage on a hit.
In addition, the ring has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.

entries.name: Frozen Wrath
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} to cast {@spell Ice Storm|XPHB}. You are immune to any damage dealt by this casting of the spell, and you ignore the {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} created by it.

entries.name: War Cry
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} after you hit with a melee weapon attack to grant {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attacks made by allies who can see or hear you against the creature you hit. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
Finally, it has the following property.

entries.name: Jarlpact Benefit
entries: If an ally within {@b 120 feet} is attuned to and wearing any other Ring of the Jarlpact, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

item.name: Ring of Hospitality
entries: This ring is fashioned to show two hands shaking in greeting. While wearing this ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) checks when you take the {@action Influence|XPHB} action to request shelter from another creature that can understand you.

item.name: Ring of Ice-Shielding
entries: This ring has {@b 3 charges}, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to form a {@b 5-foot} square, {@b 1-foot-thick} wall of ice when you are the target of an attack or are required to make a Dexterity saving throw. The wall provides {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three Quarters Cover}. If the attack misses or you succeed on your save, the ice wall explodes. Any enemies adjacent to it take {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage and {@damage 1d6} Cold damage.

item.name: Ring of Surtr
entries: This ring is roughly forged from a single wrapped shard of coal-black iron. It is warm to the touch. When you deal Fire damage to an object while wearing this ring, you deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Fire damage.

item.name: Ring of the Tempest Jarl
entries: This ring is made from a twisted piece of wood charred by lightning, and it bears runes of the storm and the sea. While wearing it, you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.
In addition, the ring has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.

entries.name: Storm Strike
entries: You can expend {@b 2 charges} when you deal damage with a melee attack. In addition to the weapon's normal damage, the target takes {@damage 8d6} Lightning damage, and it has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Windborne Leap
entries: You can expend {@b 1 charge} to cast the {@spell Jump|XPHB} spell on yourself.
Finally, it has the following property.

entries.name: Jarlpact Benefit
entries: If an ally within {@b 120 feet} is attuned to and wearing any other Ring of the Jarlpact, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

item.name: Rod of Frostbite
entries: This rod is made of blackened, desiccated skin shrunk tightly around a humanoid forearm and hand. This wand has {@b 5 charges} and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Withering Cold
entries: While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend {@b 1 charge} to cause a shadowy ray to streak from one of the rod's fingertips toward a creature you can see within {@b 60 feet} of yourself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or for 1 minute, it takes an additional {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage whenever it takes Cold damage. At the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Cast Spell
entries: You can cast {@spell Ray of Frost|XPHB} from it using your spell attack modifier. The damage scales with your level.

item.name: Salt of Thawing
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to spread this salt on a {@b 5-foot} square area within {@b 10 feet} of you. Ice up to 1-foot thick in that area instantly melts.

item.name: Sail of Favorable Winds
entries: These gorgeous sails are embroidered with swirls and contours to make them appear like fluffy white clouds. While sailing, a ship flying these sails treats any wind as though it were a tailwind, coming from straight behind the ship, and thus can maintain maximum speed without the need to tack or adjust the sails. This has no effect if the ship is becalmed and there is no wind available at all.

item.name: Seidr Rune Necklace
entries: This necklace is made of carved runes strung with giant's hair. The runes glow faintly blue. While wearing this necklace, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to learn and influence the future of one individual that you are familiar with.

You choose a type of situation from battle, diplomacy, trade, trickery, or other situation. The GM tells you if that individual is likely to encounter such a situation today. For the remainder of the day, you know when that individual is in that type of situation, and as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you may add or subtract {@dice 1d10} from a die roll they just made during that event, though you have no additional knowledge of what transpired where the individual is.
You may not take this {@action Magic|XPHB} action again until the next dawn.

item.name: Serpent Fin Oars
entries: These silvery enchanted oars are lighter and stronger than typical wooden oars and come in sets sufficient to outfit a single ship. While sailors are rowing these oars, the ship's pilot has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks to control the ship.
When a ship outfitted with these oars is adjacent to another rowed ship, the ship can take an action to slash that ship's oars, destroying them.
As long as at least one of the oars is unbroken, and that oar remains on the ship, 1 additional oar is magically produced each dawn until there are enough to outfit the ship.

item.name: Shield of the World Serpent
entries: This shield is shaped from a scale of Jormungandr. While wielding the shield, you cannot be pushed or pulled against your will. At the start of each of your turns, you may end any {@condition Grappled|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions on you.

item.name: Slip-Bane Bracelet
entries: This corded bracelet has {@dice 1d4 + 2} tiny claws hanging from it. While wearing it, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to halve damage from falling. Doing so causes one of the claws to crumble. Once all of the claws are gone, the bracelet crumbles to dust.

item.name: Songsteel Shield
entries: Metal shields made of songsteel rings like a bell or chime when they clang against an object. When holding the shield, you can call out to Volund as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Until the end of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to your AC. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

item.name: Snowbirds
entries: These three crystal figures of terns can interlock into a circle as if nestling together. Each one can be removed and buried in snow or a similarly loose material like sand or soil. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can call to a buried crystal bird within {@b 100 feet} of you. It bursts up into the air, filling a {@b 10-foot-tall, 5-foot-radius} {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} with snow, before falling back to the ground. The area within the snow burst is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} until the start of your next turn. The three snowbirds can be placed separately and activated simultaneously to obscure multiple areas.

item.name: Stormbinder's Cloak
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage while wearing this cloak. You also ignore any Obscurement created by magical or non-magical clouds, fog, or mist. Lastly, whenever you cast a level 1+ spell that deals Cold, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you may treat the spell as if you had cast it with a spell slot 1 higher than the slot used.

item.name: Stormhorn
entries: This wooden horn is carved from lightning-struck yew. It has {@b 6 charges} and regains {@dice 1d6} charges each day at dawn. It can be blown as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cast a spell—{@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} (1 charge), {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB} (2 charges), {@spell Sleet Storm|XPHB} (3 charges)— using your spell save DC.

item.name: Sustaining Belt
entries: This wide belt has short, soft grey fur on both its inner and outer faces, with a long strap bearing many more punch holes than an ordinary belt. While wearing this belt, you don't have to consume as much food or water. You can go an additional number of days equal to your Constitution modifier before you suffer the effects of starvation or dehydration.

item.name: Tireless Rower
entries: Appearing to be merely a copper statue of a seated dwarf, this duergar marvel is actually a magic and clockwork automaton. When the command word is spoken, the device duplicates itself until there are enough dwarves to row the entire ship. A single tireless rower can replace the rowing crew of a longship for {@b 8 hours}. It needs to recharge for 8 hours before it can be used again.

item.name: Titancall Dagger
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with this Dagger, you can summon a {@creature Frost Giant|XMM} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When you do, specify a target for the giant's ire.

The giant appears in an unoccupied space you choose within {@b 120 feet} of yourself and is convinced that the target has wronged them. While summoned, the giant is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies.

The giant remains for {@b 1 hour} or until it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, at which time it vanishes. After a giant is summoned, the dagger can't be used again in this way until the next dawn.

item.name: Trollkin Unguent
entries: One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes {@b 10 minutes}. The affected creature then has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage for {@b 1 hour}.

If the creature takes Fire damage, it becomes wreathed in ghostly green flames that shed {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a {@b 15-foot} radius. While ablaze, the creature's melee weapon attacks deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage. After {@b 10 minutes}, the flames die out and the oil's effects expire.
This oil is transparent with a rainbow sheen.

item.name: Tyr's Crushing Might
entries: This iron bowsprit is forged in the shape of the one-handed god Tyr in the moments after he lost his hand to the Fenris wolf. His wounded arm is hugged tight to his body, his sword thrust forward in the other, and a mighty cry upon his lips. While equipped with this item, a ship can take the Ram action for double the normal damage, and it takes no damage to itself from Ramming.

item.name: Warrior Honey
entries: When you consume this honey, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the first {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} check you make during the next {@b 1 hour}. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the first melee attack roll you make. The honey has small bubbles throughout and tingles in your stomach.

item.name: Warhammer of Giant Felling
entries: This Warhammer is inscribed with runes and pictograms dedicated to battles between dwarves and giants. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

If you hit a creature that is a larger size than you with this weapon, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

If you hit a creature that is your size or smaller, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} Thunder damage and have both the {@condition Prone|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions as it is driven into the ground. The target or a creature within reach of it can take an action to make a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check to free it.

item.name: Winged Helm of Wisdom
entries: Two black bird wings sweep back from the sides of this unusual silver helm, which has an unbroken smooth plate where the right eye hole would be, though the magical properties of the helm allow you to see through it. While wearing the helm, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 ft. for {@b 1 hour}. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land. While this effect is active, you may maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on two spells at once, and the plate where the right eye hole would be glows a ghostly blue. This ability cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: The Grave Blade

entries.name: Fabled Magic Items
entries: Fabled magic items are distinct as a rarity. A fabled item grows in power alongside the character who wields it. Rules for fabled items are summarized here, and a few fabled magic items can be found in this chapter.
A fabled magic item begins as a Common magic item. The item grants a minor, useful trait to its owner that doesn't require {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to use.

To access any higher-level trait, a PC must attune to it using standard {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} rules. Once attuned, a PC can use the fabled item's more powerful properties as they increase in level. If a PC higher than 1st level attunes to a fabled item, its level-dependent properties, up to the character's current level, are immediately available.

At the GM's discretion, an item's more powerful properties might become available only after the character completes a particular quest or event related to the item's story rather than immediately upon reaching each property's required level.
If a PC chooses not to attune to a fabled item, it remains a common magic item, granting only its minor property, regardless of the character's level.
Unless otherwise noted, properties granted by a fabled item are in effect as long at the character is wearing, carrying, or touching the item.
The pommel of this sword hums a wordless song that can be heard within a {@b 5-foot} radius when Undead are within {@b 60 feet} of it.
As your level increases, you gain the following additional properties while wielding or holding this weapon if you are attuned to it:

entries.name: 5th Level
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead. If the damage came from a creature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against it for 1 minute. Once used, the sword can't be used in this way again until the next dawn.

entries.name: 9th Level
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this sword. In addition, the sword deals an additional {@damage 1d6} Necrotic damage on a hit.

entries.name: 13th Level
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls (instead of +1) with this sword. In addition, when the sword deals damage to a living creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: 17th Level
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls (instead of +2) with this sword. If you make a successful attack roll against a creature that has 50 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or fewer, you can compel it to die. Once used, the sword can't be used in this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Skinchanger Arm Ring

While wearing this arm ring, you can comprehend and verbally communicate with ravens, wolves, and bears of all varieties so long as they are Beasts, and you can use any of the {@action Influence|XPHB} action's skill options with them.
As your level increases, you gain the following benefits while wearing this arm ring if you are attuned to it:

entries.name: 5th Level
entries: You can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to grow black-feathered wings and gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 50 feet for {@b 1 hour}. While you have these wings, your size decreases by one category—from Medium to Small, for example. You also have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Your attacks with weapons or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} deal {@dice 1d4} less damage on a hit (this can't reduce damage below 1). You can end the effect early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Once used, the arm ring can't be used in this way again until the next dawn.

entries.name: 9th Level
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls with melee weapons and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} against a creature if at least one of your allies is within {@b 5 feet} of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: 13th Level
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to give yourself {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your level. You also gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Cold damage until the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} are depleted or you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Once used, the arm ring can't be used in this way again until the next dawn.

entries.name: 17th Level
entries: The arm ring has {@b 3 charges}. You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and spend 1 charge to cast the {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} spell on yourself. The forms you can take are limited to a {@creature Raven|XMM}; {@creature Wolf|XMM} or {@creature Dire Wolf|XMM}; or {@creature Black Bear|XMM|Black}, {@creature Brown Bear|XMM|Brown}, or {@creature Polar Bear|XMM|Polar} bear. When you cast {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} in this way, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The arm ring regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Storrbani

entries.name: Fabled Magic Items
entries: Fabled magic items are distinct as a rarity. A fabled item grows in power alongside the character who wields it. Rules for fabled items are summarized here, and a few fabled magic items can be found in this chapter.

If a PC chooses not to attune to a fabled item, it remains a common magic item, granting only its minor property, regardless of the character's level.
Unless otherwise noted, properties granted by a fabled item are in effect as long at the character is wearing, carrying, or touching the item.

This longsword is supernaturally light and easy to use. Its weight is reduced to 1 pound, and it gains the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} weapon property. Sparks trail from Storrbani's blade as though it were a burning branch. When you hit a target with Storrbani, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} Fire damage as the blade burns upon impact.
As your level increases, you gain the following benefits while wielding or holding this weapon if you are attuned to it:

entries.name: 5th Level
entries: The rune Gebo appears on the blade. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can touch the rune and cast {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB} on a creature (besides yourself) you can see within {@b 60 feet}. You don't need to {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on the spell to maintain it. Once used in this way, you must finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

In addition, the spirit of Thogar Giant-Hewer awakens within the longsword. It becomes a sentient, Lawful Neutral weapon with Intelligence 8, Wisdom 13, and Charisma 10. It has hearing and vision out to a range of 60 feet. It communicates telepathically with its wielder, and it can speak in a gravelly voice much like an angry growl. It can read and understand Common and Giant. Thogar's spirit is passionate but not particularly bright. It wants the wielder to confront giants and trolls, and (secretly) to fall in glorious battle against the forces of Jotunheim so that wielder and blade may feast and fight together in eternal Valhalla. It urges its wielder to seek out and destroy evil trolls and giants, and to never back down from a fight. If its wielder displays cowardice or refuses an opportunity to battle an evil troll or other giant, the spirit sulks, suppressing the magical properties of the weapon until the following dawn.

entries.name: 9th Level
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon, and the amount of Fire damage it deals increases to {@damage 2d6}. In addition, the rune Tiwaz appears on the blade. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can touch this rune and give the extra Fire damage from this blade to the weapon of a creature you can see within {@b 60 feet}. At the end of your next turn, the Fire damage property returns to Storrbani.

entries.name: 13th Level
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon instead of a +1 bonus. In addition, the rune Thurisaz appears on the blade. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can touch this rune. When you do so, your attack rolls with this magic weapon score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 until the end of your next turn. If the target is a creature of the giant type, Storrbani deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage on a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB|critical hit}.

entries.name: 17th Level
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon, instead of a +2 bonus. In addition, the rune Ansuz appears on the blade. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can touch the rune and gain {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all damage until the end of your next turn. Once used, the sword can't be used again in this way until the next dawn.

When you hit with a ranged weapon attack using this Snaerispear, you may push the target up to {@b 10 feet} directly away from you.
As your level increases, you gain the following benefits while wielding or holding this weapon if you are attuned to it:

entries.name: 5th Level
entries: Immediately after hitting or missing an enemy, this javelin reappears to your hand.

entries.name: 9th Level
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon. In addition, when thrown, the javelin is wreathed in electricity, dealing an extra {@damage 1d6} points of Lightning damage to any target it hits.

entries.name: 13th Level
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon instead of +1. In addition, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to charge your next attack with the weapon with electricity. The next time you hit with this javelin before the end of your turn, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: 17th Level
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon, instead of +2. In addition, when you hit with this weapon, you can call down a bolt of lightning from the heavens to strike the target. This bolt deals {@damage 8d8} Lightning damage to the target and all creatures within {@b 15 feet} of it. Creatures within the blast radius are pushed {@b 15 feet} away from the target. Once used, this ability can't be used again until the next dawn.

itemGroup.name: Ring of the Jarlpact

entries.name: Jarlpact Benefit
entries: If an ally within {@b 120 feet} is attuned to and wearing any other Ring of the Jarlpact, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.

itemGroup.name: Feather Token
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to throw this black token into the air. You can see and hear through the token for one hour. The token disappears afterwards or if the distance between you and it exceeds 1 mile. The bird has the statistics of a {@creature Raven|XMM}.
items: Feather Token (Raven)|NorthlandsWorldbook
Feather Token (Snowy Owl)|NorthlandsWorldbook

entries.name: Jarlpact Rings
entries: Long ago, a set of rings was crafted to help cement a truce between warring tribes of giants. Four rival giant jarls met to don their rings in a show of peace. However, the truce lasted only until the celebratory feast, when the drunken jarls started a brawl that became a bloody combat. The rings shattered along with the peace, but fragments of the original artifacts shaped themselves into smaller versions of the rings and scattered across the Northlands.

In addition to their base powers, each ring grants an additional jarlpact benefit if at least one other jarlpact ring is attuned to a nearby ally. This benefit doesn't apply to multiple rings worn by the same character.

itemFluff.name: The Grave Blade
entries: The reavers of Wolfheim brought home many strange treasures as souvenirs and mementos from their campaigns abroad. A dwarven warrior named Essalla claimed a strange sword as her share of the spoils on one such raiding journey. Unusual in design and unadorned by dwarvish standards, it seemed destined to be a souvenir brought out only when tales of the campaign were to be told.
This sword has a dull, lifeless grey blade, and the hilt is carved from aged bone. The guard is made from ribs, and the pommel is sourced from the rounded end of a femur, both cast in bronze

The Grave Blade became known in different tales, for the threads of fate of each bearer seemed to be cut short soon after taking possession of it. It has changed hands many times over the next nine years, seemingly taken from a corpse as often as it was exchanged for gold or favors.

The blade is known for the song it hums in the presence of undead, and with the death of its carriers, the blade's song grows ever more insistent. Some say the song is a warning, while others theorize that it wants to be found and interred with the body of its first bearer.

The souvenir of so much death was lost among a merchant's wares that never reached their destination in Wolfheim, and the mystery of its song persists in tales told on dark nights when the fire burns low.

itemFluff.name: Skinchanger Arm Ring
entries: This arm ring is made from copper and is covered with a patina that cannot be removed.

There was once a sect of Northern warriors dedicated to learning from the animals in their region. Each member of the order sought to exemplify the capabilities and spirit of their chosen animal. The raven warrior was keen to observe and could travel far and fast. The follower of the wolf fought well in conjunction with others. Others had strength and endurance like bears.

These ideals were forged into an enchanted arm ring worn by the leader of the sect. Whether this magic was achieved with the aid of dwarves, druids, or sorcerers, none can say. With experience, the wearer of the arm ring could shapeshift into one of the three animals exemplified by the warriors.

Though the order won many victories on the battlefield, they couldn't be held in the employ of any one jarl. The wilds called to them, and they visited the settled lands of the North less and less as the years went by, until they were never seen again.

itemFluff.name: Storrbani
entries: Thogar Giant-Hewer earned great renown through unwavering bravery but not intellectual brilliance. His unmatched courage often forged far ahead of his reason. As a youth, he could not prevent marauding giants and trolls from destroying his village and murdering his family. Left alone on the blood-soaked snow, a fire kindled deep in Thogar's heart. From that day, he unwaveringly sought vengeance against giantfolk, not for glory or renown but in the hope his daring might earn him friends or even a new family of his own.

The Giant-Hewer became a terror to trolls and giants alike. Though not the strongest warrior and certainly never the wisest, he braved troll dens and giant camps, throwing himself into battle where others paused to strategize. Yet time and again, the people he saved turned cold. His deeds, though brave, were rarely welcome. His plans resulted in the death of everyone but himself. His traps lured giants to their doom at the expense of entire villages. Those he rescued offered no feasts of thanks, only wary glances and closed doors. The more he gave, the more alone he became, yet still he fought on believing if he was only brave enough, he could win through to find a new family.

Thogar met his end in his own typical fashion. After running across the trail of a band of storm giants heading toward a village, he foolishly attacked them in the settlement square. His blade, Storrbani, slew many giants before the others fled, but unfortunately, the fires ignited by the battle burned down half the village. Thogar's shattered body lay in the remains of the wedding feast (to which the giants had been invited), and no one came to his aid or to witness his last breath. Skalds say he died utterly alone, but when the Valkyries came to collect him, he did not wish to enter Valhalla alone. Taking pity on the brave warrior, they cast his spirit into his blade, binding it there until the day he falls again, fighting beside a true friend, so together they might enter the Hall of Golden Shields side by side.

itemFluff.name: Tordalfr's Rebuttal
entries: Tordalfr was a storm giantkin born to a human mother in a small village. After years of jibes and taunts from the children of local warriors, he snapped.

Brael, son of the village headman, and a pompous, aspiring warrior, called Tordalfr out in public, proclaiming to his assembled cronies that there was irrefutable evidence that Tordalfr was the unwanted child of forbidden lovers, and defying anyone present to offer proof to the contrary.

Tordalfr's fury reached such a pitch that the cloudless sky opened up and a bolt of lightning struck his outstretched hand, coalescing into the form of a throwing spear, which he hurled at his tormentor. The javelin struck Brael in the chest, hurling him backward and leaving a blackened, smoking crater where his heart had been. Tordalfr marched furiously from the village and never returned.

itemMastery.name: Pull
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can pull the creature 5 feet toward yourself if it is Large or smaller. When you do so, you can also move back 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}, and this does not use any of your normal movement speed.

entries.name: Throwing String
entries: This allows the snaerispear to deal more damage when thrown than in melee.

This axe has a fire-blackened blade, and its haft is wrapped with strands of unbreakable golden hair. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. The weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage on a hit.

When you hit a creature with an attack made with this magic weapon, the target has {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage until the beginning of your next turn. If the target has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage, it loses that until the beginning of your next turn, though it does not have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Fire damage. This has no effect on creatures with {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage.

A bard wielding this weapon is empowered to mix swordplay with witty repartee. If you deal damage with this weapon on your turn, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cast {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} at the same creature you damaged. If you wish, as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can also expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration, which otherwise functions as it normally would.
This axe is forged from a dark grey metal and has blue-white runes inscribed on the head. This weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} Thunder damage to any object made of ice that it hits.

The weapon has {@b 3 charges}. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can strike the weapon against an icy surface to create a 60-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} of thunderous energy. Each creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. Objects in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that are made of ice take {@damage 3d8} Thunder damage. The weapon regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

This suit of armor is made of iced steel, which legends hold originates in the frozen underworld of Niflheim. Objects made of iced steel always feel cold to the touch. While you are wearing it, you automatically succeed on saving throws against {@hazard Extreme Heat|XDMG}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells involving fire and heat.

This weapon or piece of ammunition is made of iced steel, which legends hold originates in the frozen underworld of Niflheim. Objects made of iced steel always feel cold to the touch. Damage you deal with this weapon is treated as Cold damage rather than the type the weapon normally deals, if it would be advantageous to you.
This axe channels the might of the jotun. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

This weapon has {@b 5 charges}. When you hit an enemy with a melee attack using this weapon, you can expend {@b 1 charge} to deal an extra {@damage 3d8} Force damage and push the target {@b 10 feet} away from you for every size category it is smaller than Gargantuan (Gargantuan creatures are not pushed). The weapon regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Giant's Boon
entries: While you are attuned to the weapon and wearing either a {@item Belt of Giant Strength|XDMG} or {@item Gauntlets of Ogre Power|XDMG} to which you are also attuned, the weapon regains all expended charges daily at dawn. In addition, the bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2, and the extra Force damage you deal when you expend a charge increases to {@damage 4d8}.

This piece of ammunition is made of prismatic steel infused with the power of the Bifrost. When you hit a creature that is outside of its home plane with a ranged attack with this ammunition, it is banished to its home plane for 1 round.

This suit of armor is made of prismatic steel infused with the power of the Bifrost. While you are wearing it, you automatically succeed on saving throws against effects that would push, pull, teleport, or otherwise move you against your will.

While attuned to the armor, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to teleport the armor onto or off of your body, even if it is on another plane of existence from you. When you teleport the armor off of your body, it moves to an adjacent square. You can't use this effect again until the next dawn.

This weapon is made of prismatic steel infused with the power of the Bifrost. When you hit a creature that is outside of its home plane with a melee attack using this weapon, they are banished to their home plane for 1 round. If you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with this weapon against a creature that is outside its home plane, the creature is banished to its home plane indefinitely, though it can leave of its own accord.
While attuned to the weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to summon it to your empty hand, even if it is on another plane of existence.

When you enter a Rage, you can make a melee attack with this weapon as part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} used to enter the Rage. After using this property, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

You have a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} while wearing this armor. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cause the armor to envelop you for 1 minute. You grow flippers and a thick layer of blubber, which remain for the duration. While in this state, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved, you have {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} of 30, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning damage. Once this action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Immediately after you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} with this hammer, it casts {@spell Thunderclap|XPHB}, using your level to set the cantrip's damage. Your allies have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the damage dealt by this casting of the spell.

You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your normal {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} when wearing this armor. Also, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any checks and saves to avoid or end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.
This sleek magic weapon projects a shadowy double image of itself when wielded. The weapon has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} charges each day at sunset.

entries.name: Elusive Strike
entries: When you miss with a melee attack made with this weapon, you can spend {@b 1 charge} to reroll the attack roll and use the new result.

entries.name: Phantasmal Parry
entries: While holding this weapon, you can spend {@b 1 charge} to cast the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell.

Metal armor made of songsteel rings like a bell or chime when it clangs against an object. When wearing the armor, you can call out to Volund as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Until the end of your next turn, you take 5 less damage from all attacks that hit you. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

A metal weapon made of songsteel rings like a bell or chime when it clangs against an object. When wielding the weapon, you can call out to Volund as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +5 bonus to damage rolls with this weapon. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} before you can use it again.

When you hit a creature with a ranged attack made with this magic weapon, the target is pulled {@b 10 feet} closer to you. If the target has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}, that {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
After making a ranged attack with this weapon, it returns to your hand.

This armor has {@b 3 charges} and regains {@dice 1d3} charges daily at dawn. Each time you would receive a level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, you may spend a charge to negate that {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.
As long as the armor has at least 1 charge remaining, you cannot take penalties to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

While wearing this armor, you don't have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition when you are at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. You still make {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws} normally. You can't use the {@action Help|XPHB} action to make a {@skill Medicine|XPHB} check to stabilize yourself.

spell.name: Aegir's Breath
entries: You blow a cloud of frigid air at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d10} Cold damage, or {@damage 1d12} if the target is at least partially submerged in water.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The spell creates two clouds at level 5, three clouds at level 11, and four clouds at level 17. You can direct the clouds at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each cloud.

spell.name: Angrboda's Fury
entries: When you cast this spell, you open yourself up to become a conduit of the rage of the giant goddess {@deity Angrboda|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook}. One creature within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable} to one type of damage of your choice. If the creature has {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the damage type you selected, it loses its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} and takes damage as normal, but it does not have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerability} to the damage type you chose.
The creature can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending this spell on a success.

spell.name: Aspect of the Narwhal
entries: A willing creature that you touch takes on the aspects of a narwhal. It grows flippers and a long horn-like tusk. The target gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistance} to Cold damage while submerged in water, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 5 feet, and it gains a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} of 50 feet. The target can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on any turn in which it moves at least 15 feet directly toward an enemy to make a gore attack that deals Piercing damage equal to {@damage 2d6} plus its Strength modifier.

spell.name: Awaken Ship Guardian
entries: You summon a protective spirit to live within the hull of a Large or larger ship. While the spell lasts, the ship has the following benefits:

items: {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Fire damage.

Each time the ship takes damage from a Large or larger creature, the attacking creature makes a Wisdom saving throw, taking {@damage 5d6} Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while you are on the ship, you can expend a spell slot, and the ship regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to three times the slot level plus your spellcasting modifier.

spell.name: Bearstormer
entries: You create three phantasmal grizzly bears in a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within range. Until the spell ends, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} up to 40 feet.

When the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} appears, each enemy in it makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 4d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. A creature also makes this save when the spell's area moves into its space and when a creature enters the spell's area or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You increase the size of the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} by 20-feet, the number of phantasmal bears by two, and the damage by {@dice 2d8} for each spell slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Beast of Ragnarok

components.m: a bezoar formed in a wolf's stomach

entries: The spectral aura of {@deity Fenris|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook} surrounds you as you draw Ragnarok to the world for a moment. Until the spell ends, the sky grows dark, casting the world in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 1-mile {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on you. Thick snows fall inside the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, causing the ground to become {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} and vision to be {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.
You gain the following benefits for the Duration:

items: You see clearly within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} and are unaffected by the {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} caused by the spell.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 Tests}.
All creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to all types of damage except for one. Roll a {@condition d12} to randomly determine a damage type (1. Acid, 2. Bludgeoning, 3. Fire, 4. Force, 5. Lightning, 6. Necrotic, 7. Piercing, 8. Poison, 9. Psychic, 10. Radiant, 11. Slashing, or 12. Thunder.) You have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerability} to the damage type you roll.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to resist or end all conditions.

spell.name: Bergelmir's Provocation

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature make an attack or spell attack

entries: The creature making the attack must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature makes the attack against a different eligible target of your choice, which cannot include the creature itself. If there is no other eligible target, the creature's attack is wasted.

spell.name: Beseech the Norns

m.text: a silver spindle worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

entries: You contact one of the three {@deity The Norns|Norse|NorthlandsWorldbook|Norns}, the weavers of fate, to intercede on your behalf by altering the past, present, or future. Choose one of the following effects:

items.name: Change the Past (Uror)
entries: Choose a creature you can see that died since the start of your last turn. That creature is returned to life with 1 {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB}. This spell can't revive any creature that has died of old age, nor does it restore any missing body parts.

items.name: Guide the Present (Verthandi)
entries: Treat the first attack roll or ability check you roll before the end of your turn as a natural 20.

items.name: Shape the Future (Skuld)
entries: Beginning at the start of your next turn and lasting for 1 minute, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all ability checks and saving throws.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that the spell has no effect (other than to consume the material component).

spell.name: Billowing Sails
entries: You touch a ship or other wind-powered vehicle and fill its sails with a strong breeze. Whenever the ship travels by sail, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 ft. or by 1 mph.

spell.name: Bone-Chilling Smite

time.condition: which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a melee weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}

entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 3d8} Necrotic damage from the attack, and it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} until the spell ends.

At the end of each of its turns, the {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB|Exhausted} target repeats the save. On a success, it removes all {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} caused by this spell. On a failure, it receives one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each spell slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Bound Fortunes

components.m: two small spindles bound together with thread
